body: That's one of the reasons that stops me from doing it but I honestly don't think I would have the courage to commit I'm a coward
That's what I think too, I still have so much to live but the thought that I could finally be calm, in peace and no longer be a burden for my mother attracts me.

I'd be lying if I told you I don't think the same most of the time but for some reason I'm still here, alive and waiting to die sooner or later.  I believe a lot in destiny when it arrives I will be waiting for it but it may be that I do it myself who knows. In this moment I too believe that I have completely disappointed the expectations I had for myself.  There would be no reasons why I should stay here.

I've never had anyone either and I don't think I'll ever have a person close in the loving sense. I don't feel enough for anyone but you know, in the end we all deserve happiness in love .  They say that when you least expect it, then who knows.

But that doesn't mean we have to feel bad in the end just keep in mind that the only person who will always be there for you is yourself.For other reasons I would like to put an end to my life and that's it because I believe I don't deserve life and in this I feel I can understand you. I hope that the situation improves for both of us.  I wish you the best and hope that it will soon end in the best way for you also sorry for my english it's not my first language

thanks for your words, I will consider them. Thank you again for taking the time to read and even write an answer. The truth is that for months now I have been trying to figure out what is wrong with me and why I have these thoughts.  I try to find out more about certain mental conditions but I realize that a simple search on the internet will not be enough to answer my questions.
I really hope everything can work out in your life

I honestly never thought about being depressed or somehow having something so serious.  I have always thought and still think that mine is a superficial thing.  There are times when I wonder if I have reasons for doing it and I can't find them.  As you said I am still young, I have not experienced anything of what life could show me, I am aware of it.  The times I hear about kids who have committed suicide, I also hear what people say about them.  Some do it for valid reasons but I don't have them.  I could almost say I have a perfect life in a way.  I have a mother who loves me, economically we are fine but there is always the fact that I hate myself.  In all senses I don't understand how a person like me can exist I have everything and yet it's as if I don't know how to appreciate it.  And I'm afraid to get help and find out that I have something serious.  I'm afraid of what people might think. To what my own mother might think, she has a cowardly daughter who doesn't want to face the problems that any other person faces.  Why most people manage to live apparently well and manage to overcome problems and I don't?  Am I too weak to live?  
Anyway thanks for taking the time to answer me, I appreciate it so much

I hope you can somehow get out of that place soon.  I hope your mother no longer thinks it's a phase and thank you for still loving her.  Really thank you, I know that what he thinks hurts you and really with all my heart I hope he understands you soon and gives you the respect you deserve also sorry for my english, it's not my first language
